fresh.descriptor: The day begins now, and only now.
A divine secret poured into a cup.
Earth's fiery, energetic gift to humanity.
A gentle, warm start to consciousness.
Sunrise captured in a porcelain mug.
It lubricates the rusty gears of thought.
Activates productive human mode. Now with more go.
You know it when you taste it.
A delicious antidote to the siren call of bed.
For when life demands ludicrous speed.
The sole reason to face the week's beginning.
A fleeting moment of peace before the chaos.
Enjoy it, for this feeling will not last.
Sharpens the mind for another day of labor.
A short-term lease on a stable mental state.
The brew must flow for consciousness to expand.
It powers the warp core of your soul.
We wants it, we needs it. Must have it.
A dose of Felix Felicis for your morning.
As cunning as a fox appointed Professor of Cunning.
The absolute zenith of flavor and aroma.
A royal sign of a perfectly pulled shot.
Inhaling this is half the experience.
The audible proof of perfection has been brewed.
It dances on the palate with vibrant notes.
There can be only one perfect cup.
It bends the space-time of your morning.

fresh.catcher: The Black Blood of the Earth
fresh.descriptor: A dark, powerful, and life-giving force.
Turns sleepy lead into productive gold.
Cleared for liftoff from your kitchen counter.
Transforms nocturnal gremlins into functional daytime beings.
The abstract concept of 'get up and go'.
Ctrl+Alt+Del for your weary brain.
Just add water to keep the crazy away.
A perfect creation, containing the light of inspiration.
Knowing is half the battle; this is the other.
The magic elixir that makes the sun rise.
A magical concoction derived from humble beans.
The preferred fuel for building a better day.
May the Schwartz be with you. All of it.
Turns over the sputtering engine of your mind.
A smooth taste with a powerful, roaring kick.
The result of a perfect elemental transformation.
The cup that makes the maker smile.
The very soul of a new day, distilled.
Like having brains smashed out by a lemon.
The single element that starts the reaction.
The Joy of Missing Out on being tired.
Unlocks focus, creativity, and pure productivity.
That first sip that says, 'maybe today's okay.'

good.descriptor: It holds the line against morning grogginess.
It's not fancy, but it always shows up.
Gets you from point A to point B.
Built for function, not for floral notes.
And hot! A solid, dependable cup.
The lifeblood of cubicle farms everywhere.
It meets the minimum requirements for being coffee.
Round it up; it does the job.
Armor for surviving another pointless meeting.
A +1 stamina boost for weary parents.
Push the boulder. Drink the coffee. Repeat.
A mandatory dose to maintain basic functionality.
It's coffee. That is all. Nothing more.
You drink it because you feel you have to.
Lost in time, like tears in rain.
No cell phones, just a solid, honest brew.
Would you like to know more? Just drink.
It has the right flavor, and it's... coffee-colored.
The unassuming hero of every single morning.
For survival, not for savoring or enjoyment.
Makes everyone in the office equally functional.
What about elevenses? This works for that, too.
Designed by a committee to offend no one.
Its purpose is to function, not to delight.
Brewed in a pot of questionable cleanliness.
You can always count on it to be... there.
Perfectly balanced on the centerline of mediocrity.
All other coffees are measured against this.
It's on the table. You can drink it.
Step 1: Make coffee. Step 2: Drink.
Things are normal. This coffee proves it.
The background coffee that fills every generic mug.
Temporarily suppresses symptoms of chronic grumpiness.
Reduces the friction of early morning thoughts.
Inoffensive enough to be served at any gathering.
Tastes exactly like your high school memories.
It fills the mug until better coffee arrives.
The default color and flavor setting for coffee.
Just enough bravery to open your email inbox.
It's there, and it has caffeine. Check.
No surprises, good or bad. A flat line.
The same cup, every day, forever and ever.
Makes small talk with coworkers slightly more bearable.
Gets you over the mid-week productivity slump.
Aggressively, fashionably, deliberately normal and unadorned.
Good news, everyone! It's coffee.
Just add hot water for instant functionality.
If you don't choose, this is what you get.
A low, steady hum of caffeine in your veins.
'Yes, I've had my coffee.' Technically true.

teetering.descriptor: The bright notes are setting over the horizon.

teetering.catcher: The Shadow of its Former Self
teetering.descriptor: It remembers when it used to be great.
Vaguely reminiscent of a once-perfect cup.
The moment hope gives way to acceptance.
You're better than this. Or maybe you're not.
Each sip is a reminder of bad decisions.
The coffee is crying, and so are you.
'I probably should have made a fresh pot.'
Your punishment for not drinking it sooner.
You've settled, and this is what you get.
The colors are washed out, the joy is gone.
A slow, inevitable slide into mediocrity.
The final, shuddering breath before it turns stale.
It tastes like you've completely stopped caring.
A dimension not of flavor nor of heat.
You've let it turn to the lukewarm side.
You're drinking it, but you can't taste it.
The equivalent of a 3.6 Roentgen cup.
It's coffee, don't believe me? Ask the dishes.
'Sorry I couldn't be as good as the morning.'
You don't know how long it's been there.
You drink it. You know why. It knows why.
The heartbeat of its flavor has ceased.
It looks like coffee, but the magic is gone.
A liquid monument to your morning's optimism.
Why are we here? What is flavor?
Not good enough for heaven, not bad for hell.
The cure now needs a cure of its own.
Until you taste it, it's both good and bad.

teetering.catcher: The Final Boss of the Pot
teetering.descriptor: The last dregs you have to defeat.
The only note left is a dull, flat bass.
It threatens to ruin relations with your tongue.
It could have been a contender. Now it's this.
A spectral echo of a once vibrant brew.
The official beverage of lowered standards.
Like a beautiful song with one wrong chord.
Its flavor profile has become two-dimensional.
Saying farewell to flavor, one sad sip at a time.
Close enough to coffee to be unsettling.
All the vibrant colors of taste have vanished.
Each zap in the microwave adds more bitterness.
You left it behind, and it has not forgiven.
Teetering on the precipice of becoming drain-pour.
No hostile flavors, but no friendly ones either.
It's not Monday, it's not Wednesday. It just is.
It mediates a truce between 'awake' and 'asleep.'
The sound you make after the first sip.
The definition of a near-miss in a mug.
It showed up. That's all that can be said.
It suggests the idea of coffee without delivering.

stale.descriptor: How could something once so good become this?
The charred remains of a once-great civilization.
Stare into the abyss, and it tastes back.
Ancient, bitter, and tells a tale of woe.
A sacrifice to the god of bad decisions.
What you drink when you've been very, very bad.
You'll regret this. Probably immediately.
Its highest and best use is cleansing your pipes.
For when the only other option is giving up.
You've hit the bottom of the pot and your life.
The pure, unadulterated essence of a terrible day.
Nowhere to go from here but a new pot.
Drinking this is a sign you need an intervention.
I mean, you could drink it. But why?
All sensors report flavor has ceased to exist.
A dark, cold, and bitter version of our world.
One does not simply walk away from drinking this.
A wretched hive of scum and villainy.
This flavor has to be at least three times bigger.
Smoky, but not in a good, peaty scotch way.
It has the flavor profile of a culinary mistake.
Life might evolve in it, but not good life.
Every sip atones for a past sin.
If you drink this willingly, you are not sober.
Tastes like 3 AM feels after a 12-hour shift.
Gargle with this to truly feel alive. And awful.
A test of your will, your stomach, your soul.
Distilled tears of everyone who had to drink it.
It corrupts all it touches, including your tongue.
It might be useful for cleaning car parts.
This brew violates the Geneva Convention on taste.
The taste of dreams that have been burnt away.
Tastes like waiting in line for three hours.
Slow, screechy, and deeply unpleasant to experience.
All the flavor has been replaced by white noise.
Its very existence is a disappointment to the franchise.
A taste that can drive a person to madness.
The punishment for traitors to good coffee.
Should probably be handled with gloves and a mask.
Bitter, cold, and you really should have thrown it out.
Murky, questionable, with hints of profound regret.
An unwelcome, unpleasant, and stressful experience.
The official beverage of giving up on your dreams.
Past this point, no flavor can escape.
It is known. To be terrible.
Everyone agrees it should have never been made.
Tastes like the cup it's been sitting in.
I can't go on. I'll go on. I'll drink it.
It will strip you of all free will and joy.
A passive-aggressive act of culinary warfare.

moldy.descriptor: It slumbers in its dark carafe, dreaming madly.
Do not drink, for it will change you.
A scientific impossibility that defies explanation.
The earth is taking back what was once hers.
It is both a beverage and a lifeform.
It has grown a coat to keep it warm.
Ch-ch-ch-chia! Just add neglect.
A self-sustaining ecosystem of failure.
You didn't just lose the battle, you lost the war.
There is no coming back from this sin.
A fuzzy testament to your own laziness.
The final piece of evidence that you've given up.
It perfectly imitates coffee, but it is not.
A parasitic life form bent on consuming all flavor.
Beware the spores when you pour it out.
It wants to latch onto your face. Don't let it.
It creeps, and leaps, and slides and glides!
The building blocks of new, terrifying life.
The origin point of a new and horrifying plague.
Its final destination is a sealed container.
It has achieved sentience and demands tribute.
An ambitious, fuzzy, and slightly scary project.
You might be able to retire on this discovery.
Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.
A challenging piece on the nature of decay.
It smells like the dump on a hot day.
One wrong move and you'll smell like this forever.
You'll get an 'A' for demonstrating exponential growth.
Strange and dangerous things live in there now.
Get out of my mug!
The inevitable, final state of all coffee.
If all molecules are mold, is it still coffee?
If you see it, it must be thrown out.
And I looked, and behold a pale fungus.
Even more unpleasant and covered in tendrils.
Whoever drinks this shall know no peace.
No longer a beverage, now classified as a specimen.
Do not cross the yellow tape around this mug.
'I made it, so I should...' No. Stop.
It has desecrated the holy vessel of the mug.
The worst thing in the world is in this pot.
Bound in fungus, written in regret. Do not open.
It will assimilate your mug into its collective.
Its danger is only revealed when you look closely.
We can't save it. We can only save ourselves.
Some dark and ancient evil from the First Age.
Don't blink. Don't even blink. Or it will grow.
One sip and you'll be craving brains.
Release it... down the drain. From a safe distance.
The coffee machine is now a paperweight.
